description: This file defines a React functional component for a Popover UI element, including related constants, hooks, and subcomponents like ArrowIcon. It handles positioning, visibility, and portal rendering of the popover content.

methods.name: Popover
methods.description: Main React component implementing a customizable popover with positioning, visibility toggling, and portal rendering.

methods.name: ArrowIcon
